ns2:course.label: Aerospace Systems Design II
ns2:course.description: Continuation of AE 442. Conceptual design project of either an aircraft or spacecraft flight system to satisfy a given set of requirements. Project team organization. Emphasis on sizing, trade studies and design optimization, subsystem integration, and technical communication skills. To fulfill the Advanced Composition Requirement, credit must be earned for both AE 442 and AE 443. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: AE 442.
